title: Global Lethal Autonomous Weapons Systems (LAWS) & Military AI Specifications Dataset
description: Comprehensive, structured open dataset indexing technical specifications, operational deployments, and International Humanitarian Law (IHL) compliance evaluations for Lethal Autonomous Weapons Systems (LAWS), uncrewed combat platforms, and algorithmic targeting architectures. Authored by Avi Perera.
